name: SDN Host Random Node
description: Capability node wrapping the host random.bytes hostcall. Method "bytes" takes an optional "request" frame of UTF-8 JSON bytes {"length":N} (default 32, maximum 65536) and emits one "bytes" frame of raw host-generated random bytes, passed through VERBATIM from the hostcall binary segment. Host notes: the Go node (sdn-server modulert) serves random.bytes as an ungated built-in but silently clamps length to 8192; the SDK NodeHost/BrowserHost honor the requested length but are default-deny and require the "random" capability grant, which this node declares. Downstream nodes must use the emitted frame's actual byte length, not the requested length.

externalInterfaces.description: Host CSPRNG hostcall (random.bytes). Available on the Go server host (built-in, clamps at 8192 bytes) and SDK NodeHost/BrowserHost (capability-gated).

acceptedTypeSets.description: Optional UTF-8 JSON bytes (aligned-binary wire format): {"length":N}. Default 32 when absent; 1 <= N <= 65536.
Raw random bytes (aligned-binary wire format), passed through verbatim from the random.bytes hostcall binary segment.

methods.description: Requests length random bytes from the host CSPRNG through the sync hostcall bridge and emits them verbatim.
